{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Dancer''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had high health and average speed. It had both the [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]], which made it harder to slow down. ==Logbook Description== "''When Dancers take the stage, their fractured masks conceal the agonized expressions of those trapped behind them. Known for their flexibility, they practice endlessly until dance becomes the only movement their bodies can remember''." ==Appearance== The '''Dancer''' is a dark creature which wears a red coat, tophat and shoes, all three with golden accents. On its tophat, it has a golden gear. It wears a white mask with red lipstick and cheeks. It carries a black and golden cane with its right hand. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Mercenary Base]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Warlock]] or [[Ranger]] are recommended against this. **Towers like the [[DJ Booth]] or [[Commander]] can be used to boost their statistics. *As the '''Dancer''' has both the [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]], knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] and freezing towers like the [[Freezer]] cannot be used on it. **While stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] can still be used, they will only slow it down instead of fully stopping it. **While the [[DJ Booth]] cannot knock it back, its slowdown is not affected by its immunities. **Other forms of stalling like confusion or poison are not affected by its immunities, making them pretty effective. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDancer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TheFinalActPromoImage.png|'''Dancer''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DancerIconIG.png|'''Dancer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Dancer''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Dancer''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Dancer''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Extra C]]|Wave 16|Dancer & [[Spotlight (Enemy)|Spotlight]]|Wave 18 (Easy)|hardt2 = Dancer|hardw2 = Wave 18 (Hard)|[[Stereo Man]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
